notes.title: new text interface and french language added.
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that a new release will be soon available, with a complete revision of the text interface and French language! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30733914/0c3e8bbfa45ddc08b5920627922337d56465a351.png[/img]

notes.title: New Year's Resolutions
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30733914/e57f66f365da52ce1880848e5a62ca416354ae1d.png[/img]
Greetings, dear travel companions!

So fresh from the festive break, we, the Fazz Brothers, are looking over the enticing new year’s “to do” list :

•	A mini-spin off of Peppe's quest (For free release) 
•	A big push on the second chapter of Belpaese.
•	A few cool improvements under the hood of the original.

But... one major problem! Which you guys can help with: to make it all possible, we need a little more love. Well, Peppe’s love; the kind of affection you can express with a vote.

If you liked Belpaese: Homecoming's story, and are looking forward for the next chapter, you can help us by writing so in a review.

It would be an incredibly appreciated gesture from you guys to make possible to continue Peppe’s adventure and fulfil our innermost desire: to have a lazy, foolish, vaguely chauvinist and self-involved good-for-nothing ruling the world!

Before someone presses their big red button and it's too late, please vote for Peppe!

He won’t press any button, as pressing buttons sounds like work.

Blessings,

Paolo and Andrea Fazzini,
Creators of “Belpaese: Homecoming”
